lessons.title: 1. Adding & Removing Elements (`.append()`, `.insert()`, `.pop()`)
lessons.description: Lists can be mutated in place. `.append(item)` adds to the end, `.insert(index, item)` inserts at an index, and `.pop()` removes and returns the last element.
learning_objectives: Mutate lists using append, insert, and pop

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — 5.1.1. Lists as Stacks — Data Structures (append/pop)

lessons.title: 2. Searching & Sorting (`.index()`, `.count()`, `sorted()`)
lessons.description: Find an item's index with `.index(item)`, count occurrences with `.count(item)`, and return a sorted copy with `sorted(lst)`.

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — 5.1. More on Lists (count) + Sorting — Data Structures

lessons.title: 3. Chaitana's Colossal Coaster (Concept Challenge)
learning_objectives: Count occurrences with .count() and sort with sorted()

source.name: Exercism Python Track — Chaitana's Colossal Coaster

lessons.title: 4. Task Stack (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement a task stack: add tasks with `.append()`, process the top task with `.pop()`.
learning_objectives: Implement LIFO stack with list methods

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — 5.1.1. Lists as Stacks — Data Structures
